title: 管委會
mood: furious about something tiny and knowing it
subject: two hours of a residents' committee arguing over parking space thirty-seven
caption: Mandarin hardcore punk. Fast D-beat drumming with the snare on every offbeat, two power-chord guitars played hard and doubled, overdriven bass locked to the guitars, short stop-start breaks before each chorus, gang shout-along vocals on the hook. Fast, raw and loud with a one-take energy and no polish. Shouted male lead voice, hoarse and urgent, with a crowd of voices shouting the chorus back. 184 BPM, E minor. Furious about something tiny and fully aware of it. No melodic singing, no synth, no autotune, no slow section, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - D-beat drums and power chords]

[Verse 1]
晚上八點 社區活動中心 四十張摺疊椅
今天的議題 地下室二樓 第三十七號車位
吵了兩個小時 我舉手三次 沒有人看到我
主委在念上次的會議紀錄 念錯了 沒有人糾正

[Chorus - gang vocals]
管委會 管委會
我們用兩個小時 吵一格兩公尺乘五公尺
這是我這個禮拜 最熱血的兩個小時
我恨我自己 我明天還會來

[Verse 2]
十樓的伯伯拍桌子 拍到杯子翻了
沒有人去扶 大家都在看
那攤水流到我腳邊 我也沒動
我們都是這樣活著 看著東西流到腳邊

[Chorus - gang vocals]
管委會 管委會
我們用兩個小時 吵一格兩公尺乘五公尺
這是我這個禮拜 最熱血的兩個小時
我恨我自己 我已經報名下一次

[Outro - band cuts]
散會
三十七號 下次再議
[Song ends abruptly]
